title: Design, synthesis, molecular dynamics and gene silencing studies of novel therapeutic HIF-1alpha siRNAs in hypoxic cancer cells.
authors: Singh, Jyoti; Yadav, Sneha; Sonkar, Archana Bharti; Kumar, Anurag; Shrivastava, Neeraj Kumar; Kumar, Rohit; Kumar, Dharmendra; Ansari, Mohd Nazam; Saeedan, Abdulaziz S; Kaithwas, Gaurav
one_liner_zh: 该研究用MD模拟设计靶向HIF-1α的siRNA并分析其与hAgo2蛋白的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-RNA互作建模，但对象为siRNA-蛋白而非TF-DNA，且核心是基因沉默应用，与课题关联有限。
abstract: Hypoxia inducible factors (HIFs) are heterodimeric proteins that belong to a small group of transcription factors, which mainly regulates transcription of genes under hypoxic conditions. Particularly, oxygen sensing subunit of HIF-1alpha is a predominant subtype that heterodimerizes with oxygen-independent HIF-1beta subunit, to trigger the transcription of hypoxia responsive genes. Due to poor supply of blood and rapid division of cancerous cells, tumor microenvironment exhibits low oxygen condition and therefore increased levels of HIF-1alpha. One of the promising therapeutic strategies to cancer is modulation of HIF-1alpha signaling pathway. Small interfering RNA (siRNA) mediated downregulation of HIF-1alpha has been reported to prevent growth and progression of various types of cancer and holds great promise in the cancer treatment. In this study, computational approaches were used to design potential siRNAs targeting HIF-1alpha and investigate their interaction with the human argonaute-2 (hAgo2). Molecular dynamic simulation of HIF-1alpha siRNAs-hAgo2 complexes revealed key interactions required for the efficient binding of guide strand to hAgo2 protein. Two siRNAs (S2 and S5) exhibiting strong binding with hAgo2 were further considered. Subsequently, we transfected the MCF-7 cell line with both standard HIF-1alpha and our designed siRNAs (S2 and S5). Following transfection, translation changes in the MCF-7 cells were assessed through western blotting. S2 and S5 efficiently reduced the expression of HIF-1alpha in hypoxic conditions. The aim of the present study is to understand the siRNA-hAgo2 interaction. It is also focused on the desiging of effective siRNA against HIF-1alpha.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子（HIFs）是异二聚体蛋白，属于一小类转录因子，主要调控缺氧条件下的基因转录。特别是，HIF-1α的氧感应亚基是一种主要亚型，与不依赖氧的HIF-1β亚基形成异二聚体，从而触发缺氧反应基因的转录。由于血液供应不足和癌细胞快速分裂，肿瘤微环境呈现低氧状态，因此HIF-1α水平升高。癌症治疗中一种有前景的策略是调节HIF-1α信号通路。小干扰RNA（siRNA）介导的HIF-1α下调已被报道可阻止多种癌症的生长和进展，并在癌症治疗中具有巨大潜力。在本研究中，采用计算方法设计靶向HIF-1α的潜在siRNA，并研究其与人argonaute-2（hAgo2）的相互作用。HIF-1α siRNA-hAgo2复合物的分子动力学模拟揭示了引导链有效结合hAgo2蛋白所需的关键相互作用。进一步考虑了两种与hAgo2强结合的siRNA（S2和S5）。随后，我们将标准HIF-1α siRNA和设计的siRNA（S2和S5）转染至MCF-7细胞系。转染后，通过蛋白质印迹法评估MCF-7细胞中的翻译变化。S2和S5在缺氧条件下有效降低了HIF-1α的表达。本研究旨在理解siRNA-hAgo2相互作用，并聚焦于设计针对HIF-1α的有效siRNA。
